title: Open work is untouched for someone who starts off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new technician for this test on production, staff member B (Technician role, Time Clock on, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2), so a lead and a line can belong to someone else.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, active, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to No, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2, leading one service work order in Estimate, work order 1, and added with Add Technician to line 1 of an Estimate service work order led by staff member B, work order 2, with no time recorded (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Close the Edit Staff Member window.
  3. Open work order 1.
  4. Open the Lead Technician dropdown.
  5. Open work order 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Technician is off.

Step 2:

  • The window closes.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 still shows staff member A as its lead.

Step 4:

  • Staff member A is listed last, grayed out, with the check mark.

Step 5:

  • Staff member A is still on line 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists), story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-R5: “Open work is untouched: every lead and labor line stays as it was, so S3-R7 and S3-R8 cover anyone who is no longer offered.”
  • S6-E1: “A person who appeared as a technician before release but starts with Technician off keeps every work order and line they hold (S3-E1, S3-R7, S3-R8).”
  • S3-R7: “A work order's current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 still shows as the lead on the work order and in Board View and Tech View. In the Lead Technician dropdown they are listed last, grayed out, with the check mark, and cannot be picked. Picking someone else saves at once, as today, and the former lead then leaves the dropdown.”
  • S3-R8: “Someone already on a line who is not offered per S3-R1 stays on the line. In the Edit Labor technician list they show grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today; that list is in name order, so they appear among the others alphabetically, and they cannot be unticked there. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip that can be removed with its X, unless they have logged time on the line, in which case the chip shows the existing lock and "This technician has logged time on the line and cannot be removed.", as today. Saving a line's technicians in Edit Line keeps a person who is no longer a technician on the line unless the user removed them. As today, saving also drops a person from the line who has a labor entry on the work order but is not in the location's Time Clock list (deactivated, Time Clock off, on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, or not enrolled at the location) and has no time logged on that line; such a person who is on the line only through Add Technician, with no labor entry, stays.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
